title: National Park Visits Fell To 323 Million After A Record
hook: National park visits fell to 323 million after a record.
closing: Even a modest decline affects gateway towns, park staffing, and visitor access.
question: Which national park would you visit?

segments.say: National park visits reached 331.9 million, setting the system's new record.
National park visits fell to 323 million, reversing the record during a shutdown year.
Blue Ridge Parkway still drew 16.5 million visits, showing famous sites kept pulling crowds.
